title: subjects.json: faces, heads and people per shot, and the keep-clear map (layer L1 of panorama.content/0)
description: Where the viewer looks, per shot: tracks of boxes of one class linked over the shot's sampled frames by overlap, and a 64x36 keep-clear map the planner uses to keep faces off bezels. Sampling: every Nth frame of the frame table (N = sample_stride in content.json, 12 by default, 0.5 s at 24 fps), so a shot shorter than N frames may have no sample and then says nothing (samples = 0); the planner must treat that as unknown, not as empty. Detectors: anime face v1.4_s, anime head v2.0_s_yv11, anime person v1.3_s (ONNX, GPU) and YuNet (OpenCV, CPU) all run on every sampled frame; there is no anime / live-action switch, the planner reads class, models and score. Boxes of the same class from different models on the same thing within one frame collapse to the best-scoring one that lists the models that agreed. The class `text` is reserved: no text detector runs in v0. Time and space conventions: common.schema.json.

keepclear.description: 36 strings of 64 hex digits, row 0 at the top: per cell of the 64x36 grid over the stored frame, the highest detection score (0-1 scaled to 1-15, one hex digit) of any box covering the cell, over every sampled frame of the shot; 0 where nothing was found. Null when the shot has no sample.
